dedupeText: mid century retro compilation album cover mid century modern album art split layout duotone photography 1950s aesthetic yellow header primary yellow header contrasts with deep blue duotone imagery vertical split between inset frames and main atmospheric photo circular graphic badge overlapping the lower right quadrant thin white borders defining the inset square frames yellow header blue duotone right stacked insets left mid century anthology style

retrievalProfile.description: A multi-panel layout featuring a bold yellow header with italicized display type, paired with a large duotone blue-tinted photograph and smaller inset album covers.
triggerTerms: yellow header with blue duotone photo

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-part grid composition consisting of a full-width yellow top banner, a large vertical blue-tinted photograph on the right, and two stacked square inset frames on the left containing secondary imagery.
coreVisualRelationships: Primary yellow header contrasts with deep blue duotone imagery
Vertical split between inset frames and main atmospheric photo
Circular graphic badge overlapping the lower right quadrant
Thin white borders defining the inset square frames
coreInvariants: Solid yellow header occupying the top 15-20% of the canvas
Blue-tinted duotone effect on the primary right-side photograph
Stacked square layout for secondary content on the left

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Main subject is a large-scale duotone couple on the right; secondary subjects are smaller portraits within left-side squares.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold red italicized text in the yellow header acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top header, moves down the left column of squares, and finishes on the large blue photo and circular badge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the layout is densely packed with frames and color blocks.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue duotone for the main photograph
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red for primary display text and circular badge
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the header and badge; low saturation, high value in the blue duotone area.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Italicized humanist sans-serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text is slanted (italicized) with rounded terminals
Secondary text uses clean, high-legibility geometric forms
Badge text is condensed and uppercase
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'y' has a deep, rounded descender
Uppercase 'K' features a high junction point
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Italicized display script paired with clean, condensed sans-serif for technical details.

preserve: Italic slant of the header text
Red-on-yellow color scheme for the top bar
avoid: Serif fonts for the main header
Black text in the primary display area

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the humanist feel and mid-century weight
Appropriate for the badge and secondary technical text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a layout with a solid yellow top banner. Below it, split the canvas vertically: the left side contains two stacked white-bordered squares, and the right side contains a large blue-tinted duotone photograph of a dancing couple. Place a red circular badge in the lower center-right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold red italicized text centered in the yellow header. Add condensed white and black text inside the red circular badge.

verificationChecks: Is the header background solid yellow?
Is the main photo on the right a blue duotone?
Are there two distinct square frames on the left?
Is the primary text red and italicized?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the white frame borders
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and album titles

mustAchieve: Vibrant yellow and red color contrast

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow header is perfectly horizontal
Verify the blue tint covers the entire right-side image
Check that the red badge does not obscure the main subject's face
Confirm the left squares are equal in size
recipe.reuseFormula: Yellow Header + Blue Duotone Right + Stacked Insets Left = Mid-Century Anthology Style
